children: Russia's decision to extend its diesel-export ban through the end of September will add to pressure on an already tight global fuel market, ING says. Supply disruptions from both Russia and the Persian Gulf are coinciding with stronger seasonal demand from Northern Hemisphere harvesting and Southern Hemisphere planting, say ING commodities strategists Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey in a note. Russia is the world's second-largest diesel exporter and continues to face fuel-supply disruptions amid intensified Ukrainian attacks on energy infrastructure. (farhan.rafid@wsj.com)
